english.title: Erect / display a notice / mark on / relating to land / source of water within a Manoeuvres area
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) during a manoeuvres period, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERIOD..) and within a manoeuvres area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AREA..), erected or displayed a notice or mark on or relating to

(A)_[land,]_
(B)_[a source of water,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE LAND / SOURCE OF WATER..) within that area, representing or implying that the use of that

(C)_[land]_
(D)_[source]_

was not authorised when that notice or mark did not indicate a restriction imposed by or under the Manoeuvres Act 1958
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(2)(c) of the Manoeuvres Act 1958.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
within a Manoeuvres area and during a Manoeuvres period
erected or displayed a notice or mark, other than one indicating a restriction imposed by or under the Manoeuvres Act 1958,
on or relating to land or a source of water within the Manoeuvres area
representing or implying that the use of that land or source was not authorised

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
